# Rive canvas runtime

Official @rive-app/canvas, version 2.49.4, MIT.
Source: https://github.com/rive-app/rive-wasm
Downloaded from registry.npmjs.org and verified against the published SHA-512
integrity before unpacking. Only rive.js and rive.wasm are shipped.
No installation or build step is required on the application server.

When supplied, `static/pets/bunny/character.riv` is the selected artwork:
Cute Bunny Interactive Character by metamom_mama (CC BY),
https://rive.app/marketplace/25456-47507-cute-bunny-interactive-character/
The artwork is separate from the runtime license. Attribution is shown in the
pet settings when this file is present. The runtime always uses the local wasm.
